snapshot_note: Rules from the Frontiers author guidelines, which apply to every Frontiers journal. The reference style (Harvard or Vancouver) and the limits for each article type differ by journal: SubmitReady reads those from the journal's pages on every run.

sources.name: Frontiers help center: reference style per journal

csl_style.note: Depends on the journal: Harvard (frontiers.csl) or Vancouver (frontiers-medical-journals.csl); see the help center page.

requirements.rule: Recommended sections for Original Research: Introduction, Materials and methods, Results, Discussion (or the equivalents in your field)
requirements.quote: it is recommended to organize your manuscript in the following sections or their equivalents for your field.

requirements.rule: Five to eight keywords
requirements.quote: Pick 5-8 keywords using a mix of generic and more specific terms on the article subject(s)

requirements.rule: Word count and number of figures and tables are stated on the first page
requirements.quote: Please indicate the number of words and the number of figures and tables included in your manuscript on the first page.

requirements.rule: Abstract is one paragraph with no citations of references, figures or tables
requirements.quote: Minimize the use of abbreviations and do not cite references, figures or tables.

requirements.rule: Introduction has no subheadings
requirements.quote: Succinct, with no subheadings.

requirements.rule: Whole document single-spaced
requirements.quote: The entire document should be single-spaced and must contain page and line numbers in order to facilitate the review process.

requirements.rule: Line numbers
requirements.quote: The entire document should be single-spaced and must contain page and line numbers in order to facilitate the review process.

requirements.rule: Page numbers
requirements.quote: The entire document should be single-spaced and must contain page and line numbers in order to facilitate the review process.

requirements.rule: Each figure is a separate file, in the order cited
requirements.quote: We require figures to be submitted individually, in the same order as they are referred to in the manuscript

requirements.rule: Figure captions at the end of the manuscript; tables at the end with the caption just above
requirements.quote: Figure captions should be placed at the end of the manuscript.

requirements.rule: Figures: TIF/TIFF, JPEG or EPS, RGB, 300 dpi at final size, 85 mm or 180 mm wide, text at least 8 pt
requirements.quote: All images must have a resolution of 300 dpi at final size.

requirements.rule: Generative AI use is acknowledged in Acknowledgements (and Methods where relevant), with name, version, model and source
requirements.quote: such use must be acknowledged in the acknowledgements section of the manuscript and the methods section if applicable.

requirements.rule: Gene symbols in italics, with approved (HGNC) nomenclature
requirements.quote: Italicize gene symbols and use the approved gene nomenclature where it is available.

requirements.rule: Equations in an editable equation-editor format
requirements.quote: Equations should be inserted in editable format from the equation editor.

requirements.rule: Supplementary files have no tracked changes, highlights or line numbers, and include their caption
requirements.quote: please ensure that all information is clearly presented without tracked changes/highlighted text/line numbers, and the appropriate caption is included in the file.

requirements.rule: Headings for data availability, author contributions, conflict of interest and funding are not stated on the guidelines page; check the Frontiers Word template
Tables at the end of the manuscript, editable, with the caption just above each table
requirements.quote: Tables should be inserted at the end of the manuscript in an editable format.

requirements.rule: At most 5 heading levels
requirements.quote: You may insert up to 5 heading levels into your manuscript

requirements.rule: References list the first six authors, then et al., with the DOI when available
requirements.quote: The names of the first six authors followed by et al. and the DOI (when available) should be provided.

requirements.rule: Website URLs go in footnotes, not the reference list
requirements.quote: Website URLs should be included as footnotes.

requirements.rule: Read on the journal's own pages: reference style (Harvard author-date or Vancouver numbered, per the help center), and word, abstract and figure limits on the 'Article types' page
requirements.quote: Frontiers' journals use one of two reference styles, either Harvard (author-date) or Vancouver (numbered).
